description: This Java source file defines a Spring Shell component for managing mock door lock devices, including listing, adding, locking, unlocking, toggling, setting low battery status, and managing PIN codes.

classes.name: DoorLockDeviceShell
classes.description: Spring Shell component for managing mock door lock devices, providing commands for listing, adding, locking, unlocking, toggling, low battery status, and PIN management.

classes.name: DoorLockDeviceShell.NameValueProvider
classes.description: Inner class extending DeviceNameProvider to supply device names for door locks.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists all door lock devices in a table format.

methods.name: addDoorLock
methods.description: Adds a new mock door lock device with a specified or default name.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Locks the specified door lock device.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the specified door lock device.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the lock state of the specified door lock device.

methods.name: lowBattery
methods.description: Sets the specified door lock device as having low battery.

methods.name: lowBatteryRestore
methods.description: Removes the low battery status from the specified door lock device.

methods.name: lowBatteryToggle
methods.description: Toggles the low battery status of the specified door lock device.

methods.name: addPin
methods.description: Adds a PIN code to the specified door lock device.

methods.name: getPins
methods.description: Retrieves and prints PIN codes from the specified door lock device.
